description: Fork of exp200 (per-layer pos kept). LUT changes: nap 6 -> 8 (64 -> 256 cells/table, more discriminating per table), tph 4096 -> 1024 (fewer tables but each bigger). smooth_mode False -> True (soft forward via rational pair projection). n_alt=1 unchanged. LUT params per block stay 8.39M (1024*256*1*32 = 4096*64*1*32). Pair coverage: tph*nap = 8192/73536 = 11.1% (vs exp199's 33.4%). Hypothesis: bigger per-table buckets + smooth gradients should resolve the LUT plateau around 2.0.
